sentences.en: It supports visualisation of three-dimensional data sets for applications such as satellite and medical imaging, molecular modelling, and image compositing.

sentences.en: Cronenberg maintains that a literal visualisation would have cost US$400 million and been banned in every country in the world.

sentences.en: The objectives are: better presentation and visualisation, interpretation of outputs, and understanding.

sentences.en: If they do, it is no longer a visualisation but a clairvoyant vision.
